adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` is assigned to `res`, and the code reads `const token = res?.data;` then dereferences `token.access_token`. But `refreshOAuthTokens`’ sync branch returns the native `fetch(...)` `Response` object (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`), which does not have a `.data` property. Therefore `token` is `undefined` and `token.access_token` will throw at runtime when the credential-sync path is enabled.
